overrides.reason: Use the ten frozen light and dark effect styles for CSS shadow-layer pixels, reconciled with pinned Material Web.
overrides.gapReason: Compose specifies shadow elevation but delegates shadow raster geometry to its platform renderer; it has no CSS key and ambient layer coordinates.
